original_caption: A light blue denim jacket with a classic fit, featuring button closures down the front, flap chest pockets, and long sleeves. The jacket has a straight hem and subtle distressing on the elbows.
edit_instruction: Remove one sleeve to create an asymmetric look and add a small pocket above the flap chest pocket on the side without the removed sleeve.
resulting_caption: A light blue denim jacket with a classic fit, featuring button closures down the front, an asymmetrical design with one sleeve missing. The jacket has a straight hem, subtle distressing on the elbows, and a small additional pocket above the flap chest pocket.

original_caption: An olive green cotton cardigan with a crew neckline, long sleeves, and ribbed cuffs. The cardigan is open fronted and features two side pockets.
edit_instruction: Cut off 5 inches from the bottom hem to create a shorter length and add lace trim along the hem edge.
resulting_caption: An olive green cotton cardigan with a crew neckline, long sleeves, ribbed cuffs, and lace-trimmed hem. The cardigan is open fronted and features two side pockets.

original_caption: A black leather bomber jacket with a standing collar, snap closures down the front, and welt pockets at each hip. The jacket has long sleeves.
edit_instruction: Shorten the sleeves to elbow length and add decorative metal studs along the cuffs and hemline.
resulting_caption: A black leather bomber jacket with a standing collar, snap closures down the front, and welt pockets at each hip. The jacket has elbow-length sleeves with decorative metal studs along the cuffs and hemline.

original_caption: A pastel pink sleeveless vest with a scoop neckline and thin shoulder straps. The vest features two patch pockets on the chest.
edit_instruction: Add wide, ribbon-like ties at the sides to create adjustable slits and shorten the back panel to form an A-line shape.
resulting_caption: A pastel pink sleeveless vest with a scoop neckline, thin shoulder straps, and wide ribbon-like ties at the sides for adjustable slits. The vest features two patch pockets on the chest and is slightly A-lined towards the hem.

original_caption: A bright yellow turtleneck sweater with short sleeves and a fitted silhouette.
edit_instruction: Crop the top just below the bustline to create a cropped look, adding a high slit on one side for movement.
resulting_caption: A bright yellow cropped turtleneck sweater with short sleeves and a high slit on one side.

original_caption: An off-white cable-knit pullover featuring long sleeves, a crew neckline, and textured ribbing at the cuffs and hem.
edit_instruction: Trim the bottom 3 inches to create a more fitted look and add a single front pocket near the hip level.
resulting_caption: An off-white cable-knit cropped pullover with long sleeves, a crew neckline, and a single front pocket near the hip level.

original_caption: A soft grey hoodie featuring a drawstring hood, long raglan sleeves, and kangaroo pouch pockets. The hoodie has ribbed cuffs and hem.
edit_instruction: Crop to just below the hips and adjust the hood for a snug fit with metal rings and toggles instead of drawstrings.
resulting_caption: A cropped grey hoodie featuring a snug-fitting hood secured by metal rings and toggles, long raglan sleeves, kangaroo pouch pockets, and ribbed cuffs and hem.

original_caption: An off-the-shoulder top made from floral-patterned silk with a fitted bodice and flared skirt.
edit_instruction: Trim the garment to just below the waistline and add decorative lace along the hem edge.
resulting_caption: A cropped floral-patterned silk top with an off-the-shoulder neckline, fitted bodice, flared waistband area, and lace trim along the hem.

original_caption: A long-sleeved chiffon blouse in a pastel shade of blue with delicate ruffles at the cuffs and collar.
edit_instruction: Shorten the sleeves to three-quarter length and add buttons down the front placket for closure.
resulting_caption: A three-quarter sleeve chiffon blouse in a pastel shade of blue featuring delicate ruffles at the cuffs, a button-down front placket, and a long hemline.

original_caption: An emerald green blazer with notch lapels, two welt breast pockets, flap hip pockets, and single-button closure.
edit_instruction: Cut off 4 inches from the bottom to create a cropped look and add an extra pocket on one side.
resulting_caption: A cropped emerald green blazer featuring notch lapels, two welt breast pockets, an additional pocket on one hip, flap hip pocket on the other side, and single-button closure.
